formula.description: The molecular formula to build, written plainly, e.g. H2O, CH4, NH3, C2H6, CH4O. Only H, C, N and O are available, and the builder models SINGLE BONDS ONLY — never ask for a molecule that needs a double or triple bond, so no O2, no CO2, no N2, no CH2O.

name.description: The common name of that molecule, e.g. water, methane, ammonia, ethane, methanol.
